recipe_metadata.name: modified_methanobacterium_medium
recipe_metadata.notes: Source: JCM Medium 1427. FeCl2, trace-element, clarified-rumen-fluid, and vitamin stocks are expanded or cross-referenced from JCM Mediums 187, 266, and 898.

preparation_steps.description: Mix components and autoclave under a N2-CO2 (80:20, v/v) gas mixture.

After cooling, aseptically and anaerobically, add the following solutions from anaerobic stocks (filtersterilized): Dispense the medium into culture vessels (e.g., 5 ml medium in Hungate tubes) under a H2-CO2 (80:20, v/v) gas stream and seal with butyl stoppers.
Prior to inoculation, add per liter the following solutions (autoclaved and stored under a N2 atmosphere): After inoculation, pressurize the inoculated culture vessels to 100 kPa H2-CO2 (80:20, v/v).
